authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism in texture and lighting but suffers from structural artifacts typical of AI generation. Specifically, the central group of koalas shows limb fusion and anatomical ambiguity where bodies merge into one another without clear separation (confirmed by animal_pose_auditor showing 53% low-confidence keypoints and HIGH artifact risk). The tree branch also shows slight geometric warping under the weight of the animals. However, individual features like fur texture, facial details, and flower petals are rendered with high fidelity. The failure to render blue koalas is an instruction adherence issue, not an authenticity defect.
